items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And we got to, uh, that's how we got to know Jolly Roll.

ctx.x: We had always kept house, you see, and then, for fun, we just lived there, you know.
And his grandmother, we always lived with her when we'd go to Bay St. Louis, the room, you know, she'd do this room. And we got to, uh, that's how we got to know Jolly Roll.
